title: Vaishnavite temple – Srirangam
subject: History
caption: Diagram of the Srirangam Vaishnavite temple highlighting its key architectural elements and sacred status as a Swayam Vyakta Kshetra and Divyadesam.
altText: A photorealistic, high‑resolution educational textbook illustration on a white background of the Srirangam temple complex. The drawing shows the massive Rajagopuram at the entrance, seven concentric walls (prakaras) surrounding the central sanctum where the Ranganatha deity sits, a large temple tank in the middle, and the river Kaveri flowing nearby. Each element is clearly labelled with arrows and text boxes: 'Rajagopuram – main gateway tower', 'Prakara 1‑7 – concentric enclosures', 'Garbhagriha – sanctum with Ranganatha', 'Temple Tank', 'River Kaveri', plus notes stating 'Swayam Vyakta Kshetra' and 'Divyadesam'. A legend and scale bar are included for reference.
